title: The exact-operation presentation of etale closed costalks
statement: For a scheme X and commutative ring sheaf R on its small etale site, take the ordinary unbounded derived category of R-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For any scheme morphism f:X → Y construct ring inverse image by the existing left-Kan-extension/sheafification functor, its canonical adjunction, and module direct image with scalar action restricted through the ring unit. Direct image is additive. These are the identical six constructions used to state the etale closed-costalk comparison; only their module location changes.

source.place: The module categories, actual inverse image and exact closed direct image in the middle projection identity.

proof.text: Specialize Mathlib ringedSiteModules and standard derived localization; use the canonical ring sheaf pullback construction and its adjunction. Apply SheafOfModules.pushforward to the unit followed by forgetful scalar restriction. Its morphism components preserve addition definitionally.
